<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תמוז_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919340_theRebbe_24" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_9E_D7_95_D7_96_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919340_theRebbe_24__p010">
  <section v="27">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through the maamar "Ten Who Sit" given by the Baal HaGeulah to teach on the holiday of redemption, he made each person his agent to engage in this matter, granting special power for success in establishing public classes and all related matters.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">b)</t>
    <t s="2">And one may add,</t>
    <t s="3">that through the maamar "Ten Who Sit and Engage in Torah" given by the Baal HaGeulah to be taught on the holiday of the redemption,</t>
    <t s="4">he made each person his agent to engage in this matter,</t>
    <t s="5">and gave him a special empowerment to succeed in this,</t>
    <t s="6">success in establishing public classes,</t>
    <t s="7">and success in all the matters</t>
    <t s="8">(explained in the maamar)</t>
    <t s="9">that are drawn down through the public engagement in Torah.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="28">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>All this is in the manner of the Priestly Blessing, where the drawing down of blessing is with swiftness, transforming the bitter almonds of the three oaths into joy in the true and complete redemption through Moshiach Tzidkeinu.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And all this is in the manner of the Priestly Blessing,</t>
    <t s="1">that the drawing down of blessing is in a manner of swiftness,</t>
    <t s="2">as explained in Likkutei Torah on the discourse "And behold, the staff of Aharon blossomed... and produced almonds"74,</t>
    <t s="3">and through the good almonds of the staff of Aharon, the bitter almonds75</t>
    <t s="4">of the three oaths76</t>
    <t s="5">will be transformed into joy and gladness,</t>
    <t s="6">in the true and complete redemption through Moshiach Tzidkeinu,</t>
    <t s="7">speedily in our days, literally.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
